state: Prespecified final method and assessment declaration; prospective generation requires a separate source freeze manifest.
purpose: Test internal timely incumbent delivery in execution-locked adaptive V9 against unchanged V8/V7/stable-retain and native HiGHS; retain every deadline loss and negative result.

generator.independence: Every business scenario has a new unique base seed across both panels. Three repeated algorithm seeds/timing runs share that one business scenario and are not independent business samples. Do not replace infeasible, duplicate, slow or costly cases.

panels.interpretation: Same unchanged generator and four private-duration patterns as prior V7/V8, with new independent generator seeds not used in development.
New repeated/unannounced-recovery/sequential-resource/gradual-recovery shock patterns; all initial orders remain known. No planner knows a future event or private duration.

shockCapacityRule: For each event: capacity=max(0, nominal capacity on revealDay-ceil(nominal*reductionNumerator/reductionDenominator)). Only simulator receives duration. No announcedDuration.

budget.execution: Cold separate POSIX process group per episode; all methods execute serially, cyclic method order changes by scenario and repeat. Python descendants are group-killed on timeout and after worker exit.
budget.clock: Parent time starts before fork; includes imports, planner.ready native startup, all decisions, child terminal dual audit, planner.close cleanup, IPC and parent receipt audit. Only receipts fully validated by 5000ms count as complete.
budget.callBudgetCaveat: V5 uses legacy solver-internal seconds; V7/V8/V9 and native HiGHS use cooperative whole-call milliseconds. Native startup is charged to parent 5000ms and separately reported. V9 accepts candidates only after synchronous clone, independent reconstruction, lock/physical audit and outer gate time checks; no observer or parent IPC acknowledgement affects formal daily acceptance. Per-call clocks are not claimed identical.

analysis.repeatAggregation: Equal scenario weighting: within each pair, average matching jointly completed repeats in each scenario, then aggregate scenario means. Also disclose raw paired episode totals and paired-repeat counts.
analysis.panels: Always separate. Do not pool same-distribution and stress into a ranking.

freezePolicy: Before the first prospective generation: finish methods and independent review, fix all budget/parameter/analysis declarations, freeze all source and protocol SHA256 in a new artifacts directory. Verify live and frozen source hashes, then import both generator and workers from the frozen source snapshot. No prospective input generation or trial runs before root-authorized freeze; no replacing negative cases or overwriting a first run.
analysisRules: 144 new business scenarios (72 per panel) x 3 retained algorithm/timing repeats x 5 methods = 2160 episodes; not 432 independent scenarios. Previous V8 scenarios are development regression data and cannot become new holdout evidence.
Keep all failures, deadline losses, audit rejections, unknown histories, zeros, negative fee savings and completion gains/losses.
Incomplete episode fees are null. Missing terminal history/counters are null or unavailable, never zero.
Report V9 vs V8/V7/V5/native HiGHS and native HiGHS vs V7. Each pair uses its own matching-repeat jointly completed fee set; never rank methods across different paired denominators.

Report total and incremental fee numerator/denominator, win/tie/loss, worst losses, revisions and scenario-cluster bootstrap intervals. Bootstrap conditions on the completed pair set and does not remove completion-selection bias.
A full-path experiment includes differing initial plans. It cannot isolate recovery ability under a shared execution history; that requires a separately declared diagnostic experiment.
Only synthetic known-order daily atomic truck/warehouse/staging model conclusions are supported. Native HiGHS is a same-model baseline; no guarantee of production savings or first place.

All full episode histories, observations, date choices, candidateDelivery receipt sequences and endpoint proofs, adaptive explanations and terminal audits are append-only standalone files with hashes; only redundant planner debug/cache pricing metadata may be compacted.
First-run artifacts are never overwritten. Reproductions require a distinct output directory and preserve every repeat.
Duplicate generated order-list fingerprints, if any, are disclosed without resampling.

deliveryEvidence.policy: Internal synchronous constructor onCandidate -> outer gate; formal observer disabled; no parent candidate stream or enqueue acknowledgement.
deliveryEvidence.retention: Retain complete receipt sequence, dates, independently reconstructed fees, timing fields, accepted and rejected gate outcomes without truncation. Internal constructor firstIncumbentMs is not acceptance evidence.
deliveryEvidence.unknownHistory: No timely whole-episode terminal receipt means complete fees, execution counters and history remain null/unavailable; absence of gate evidence is not proof that no candidate physically existed.

developmentSeparation.previousV8: The original 144-scenario first V8 run and all negative outcomes remain unchanged. Its seeds may be used only as development/regression evidence for V9.
developmentSeparation.newSeeds: 391001..391072 and 392001..392072 are prospective input seed commitments, never to be used for tuning before the source freeze.
developmentSeparation.budgetSelection: Retain existing 200ms per-call and 5000ms cold episode limits. No selection of a daily budget from prospective results.
developmentSeparation.methodsOmitted: V6 omitted to keep the same 2160-episode cost; V7, V8, stable-retain and native HiGHS provide the direct historical/availability baselines.
